title: Learning is synaptic change that lowers free energy

statements.text: Perceptual learning is change in synaptic efficacy that minimizes free energy averaged over stimuli. This predicts associative plasticity and, for dynamic models, spike-timing-dependent plasticity.

sources.quote: Similarly, learning emerges from changes in synaptic efficacy that minimize the free energy, averaged over all stimuli encountered.
In terms of synaptic physiology, it predicts associative plasticity and, for dynamic models, spike-timing-dependent plasticity.
